title: Understanding MSE on Test Data
text: When you remove a feature from a model, it can affect the model's ability to generalize to new data. Consider how this might impact the MSE on held-out test data.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: Removing a feature can lead to a simpler model, which might reduce overfitting. However, it can also lead to underfitting if the feature was important. How might these changes affect the test MSE?

title: Analyzing Test MSE Changes
text: Consider both scenarios: 1) The removed feature was not important, leading to reduced overfitting. 2) The removed feature was important, leading to underfitting. What are the possible effects on test MSE?
